name: shapeforge-range
description: A tiny first-person shooting range built on the ShapeForge Engine, with an M4A1, a .338 sniper rifle and a pump shotgun modelled and animated in the engine. Also home to ShapeWatch (shapewatch/), a 5v5 hero-shooter payload game.

scripts.test: node tools/test-weapons.mjs && node tools/test-props.mjs && npm run test:shapewatch
scripts.test:shapewatch: node shapewatch/tools/test-maps.mjs && node shapewatch/tools/test-modes.mjs && node shapewatch/tools/test-kits.mjs
